section.title: Purpose
section.s: N-26 runs the full suite set on every new main sha as pods and posts coq/gate on that main sha, so that the question "is main green" has one answer that the machine wrote, GitHub holds, and N-10 reads to post verified or rejected and to set the merge hold.

It is the owner's ruling made code: verify belongs to the system, never a seat or the architect (D11, ruling C39; HANDOFF ruling H04 replaced; SPEC-17 O4 superseded), the full suite runs once on main not per pull request (roadmap ruling 18:32Z), and verification coalesces to the newest main sha with a green verifying the whole range (roadmap ruling 19:41Z).
Input to output: a merge record (N-09) starts it; a main.gate.status record ends it; N-10 decides verified, rejected and the hold.

record.s: Written by N-09 when a pull request merges; the schema is N-09's merge record by reference (../N-09/record.schema.json#/$defs/merge: shared envelope and UTC-stamp id). The level-triggered tick also treats any main sha in the forge:snapshot entity newer than the last main.gate.status as a main to verify (a push outside the factory or a lost record); that main has no merge record, so its status carries merge_seq 0 and N-10 fails closed on it.
record.field: The new main commit and its order key.
The pull request merged and its WO id.
The main sha this merge landed on (N-09 reads it back), the start of the range when the previous main is verified.
The merge_seq of the merge record whose merge_sha is main_sha, 0 when none; N-10 orders by it.
Every suite of suites.json full with its exit code, result and log url.
success, failure, error (as posted on coq/gate for main_sha).
The last main sha with a success, exclusive; the range this verdict covers.
Every merge record (sha, pr, ticket) in range_from..main_sha, so N-10 can post one verified per pull request or one rejected naming them all.
The attempt whose results produced the verdict.
The unit and log N-10 names in the rejected record.
The gate.run record id (N-25) for the main sha.
The newer main sha when this run was coalesced away (code 410, state error); N-10 accepts it and writes nothing.

section.title: Mechanism: the full set, coalescing to the newest main, the range, the status on main
section.step: Preconditions as in N-23 step 1: job.registered, namespace.ready and an image record for every image; a missing one writes main.plan.blocked 423 with one card; the merge stays unverified and the hold question is N-10's (a main with no verdict is not green).

Coalescing: on every tick the node takes the newest main sha in forge.snapshot; if a main.plan is in flight for an older sha, it is superseded (410), its build stopped, its status on that older sha posted error superseded by N-25, and a new plan starts for the newest; so at most one main run is in flight and it is always the newest main.

The plan: N-23's code with kind main: suites.sh full from the map at main_sha (for main the map and the head are the same commit), expanded to units with images and budgets, written as main.plan with pr 0, handed to coq-gate with KIND=main; the plan always contains every suite in suites.json full, so a suite with no image refuses the plan (412) and the card names it, never a silent skip.
N-24 runs every unit; N-25 posts coq/gate pending then the verdict on the main sha with the same rule and the same plan attempts for infrastructure (shared/retry-budget.xml#plan-attempt).

The range: range_from is the newest main sha with a main.gate.status success; merges is every merge record whose merge_sha is an ancestor of main_sha and not an ancestor of range_from (git merge-base --is-ancestor in the mirror, 3 tries), each with its merge_seq; with N-09's awaiting-verify step the range is the one merge whose parent_main is range_from, and the ancestry check proves it rather than assumes it (verify-main.sh breadcrumb item 2).

main.gate.status is written from the gate.run of the main sha with merge_seq, suites and the range attached; N-10 reads it: success means verified 201 for each merge in the range and the hold lifts when the held sha is in the range; failure or error means rejected 422 plus merge.hold with the first failure and the merges named. N-10 does not bisect (nodes/N-10/spec.xml#rejected r-bisect): N-09 lets at most one unverified merge onto main (nodes/N-09/spec.xml#m-awaiting-verify), so a red range is one merge; a longer range happens only after a push outside the line, and it is named whole in the rejected record.
Priority: a main run is triggered before any waiting pull request plan (N-23 section many-agents), because every ready merge waits merge.held awaiting-verify until this run's verdict.
section.mermaid: flowchart LR M[merge record or newer main sha in the snapshot] --> C{a main run in flight for an older sha?} C -- yes --> X[supersede it: stop build, status error superseded] C -- no --> P X --> P[main.plan: suites.sh full at main sha, every suite has an image] P --> R[N-24 pods, N-25 verdict on the main sha] R --> S[main.gate.status with range_from and merges] S --> N10[N-10: verified per merge, or rejected plus merge.hold]
section.s: Why the status lives on the main sha too: branch protection reads pull request heads, but the owner's rule is that main must be proven after the merge (merge-with-target can differ from the head; a suite outside the plan can break), and a status on main is the same channel N-08 already reads, so N-10 needs no second mechanism.

section.title: How it starts without an agent typing
section.s: N-09's machine merge writes the merge record; the tick plans the newest main within one tick; a push to main by anyone else is seen by the poll and verified the same way; nothing is typed.
At service start the comparison runs once: the newest main sha without a main.gate.status and without a plan in flight is planned.
A verifier seat, a merger seat and the architect have no part: the roles are retired (D11), and the route rows that woke them are deleted in the seat contract.

section.title: Every wait, its timeout and its fallback

wait.on: The full set finishing: about 68 units at 4 per build on a Pi cluster (L07 section 5 item 8 counted 61 case pods plus the other suites).
wait.timeout: main.run_bound_seconds, d-main-run of shared/retry-budget.xml#deadlines (the planner bound plus N-25's gate run bound: the build bound d-build times the plan attempts of shared/retry-budget.xml#plan-attempt); N-10's verify bound d-verify is derived from it plus 600 s, so N-10 never declares a run missing while it is inside its own bound.
wait.fallback: Missing results are infra; N-25's plan attempts (shared/retry-budget.xml#plan-attempt); after the last, error on the main sha, main.gate.status 500, N-10 sets the hold and one card goes up, because an unverifiable main must not take merges.

wait.on: A newer main arriving while a run is in flight.
wait.timeout: None: supersession is immediate on the tick that sees the newer sha.
wait.fallback: Not a wait; the older run's partial results are kept as records with 410 for the stats screen.

wait.on: The mirror answering git merge-base for the range.
wait.fallback: The record is written with merges empty and range_from unknown and code 500 reason range-unavailable; N-10 treats it as rejected for safety (the hold is the safe side, verify-main.sh breadcrumb item 3); the next tick retries the range computation and rewrites a new record when it succeeds.

section.s: Every other wait is N-23's, N-24's and N-25's, with their bounds.

section.title: Retries, recovery and the report
section.s: Infrastructure: N-25's plan attempts (shared/retry-budget.xml#plan-attempt) over N-24's pod ladder, the innermost layer retrying (shared/retry-budget.xml#innermost); results never retried; a red main is fixed by a fix ticket cut at N-03 through N-10's re-entry (dag.md section 4), up to 3 fix attempts then the owner's card.
Coalescing is not a retry: a superseded run counts no attempt against the newer sha.
After a crash the newest main sha without a verdict is planned again; a build that ran meanwhile is re-attached by its number in the main.plan record.
The report: a main.gate.status 422 or 500 always carries the merges it covers and the first failure, so the card N-10 raises names the tickets.

section.title: Many agents at once
section.s: Many merges at once: N-09 merges one at a time (its own lease), but two merges can land within one tick; the newest main is the one verified and its range carries both merges, so no merge is ever unverified and no main is verified twice.

A merge during a main run cannot come from the line: N-09 holds every merge awaiting-verify while a merge on main has neither verified nor rejected (nodes/N-09/spec.xml#m-awaiting-verify), the fix pull request included, so the line never supersedes its own main run and verification cannot be starved (F13). A push outside the line still supersedes (410) and the newer main carries both in its range; N-51 counts that push.
Pull request runs and the main run share the pod quota: two runs in flight, main first; a pull request plan waits in the store and the map shows it.
Two Go service instances: the plan lease with a fencing token; the loser's writes are 409.
Seats: none take part; a worker whose merge is in a rejected range sees the rejected record and the fix ticket; nobody re-verifies by hand.
Collision answer in one line: one main run at a time keyed by the newest sha, supersession on the tick, ranges carry every merge, lease with fencing, merges held by N-09 while main is unverified.

section.title: Status codes this node emits
section.emits: N-24 runs the units; N-25 posts pending on the main sha.
N-10 posts verified per merge and lifts the hold when the held sha is in the range.
N-10 posts rejected naming the merges and sets merge.hold; a fix ticket re-enters at N-03.
Infrastructure after the last plan attempt or range unavailable: N-10 sets the hold; one card.
Coalesced away by a newer main; nobody acts.
A suite without an image: one card; the hold stays until fixed.

item.check: Every merge to main is followed by a main.gate.status that covers it.
item.proof: A daily query: every merge record's sha is in some main.gate.status merges array within main.run_bound_seconds (d-main-run); the alert otherwise.

item.check: Only the newest main is run; an older in-flight run is superseded.
item.proof: Scenario coalesce in ci/tests/cases/02-gate-pipeline.test.sh with the fake Jenkins: two merges, one stop call, the older sha's status error superseded, the newer sha's range has both merges.

item.check: The full set runs every suite in suites.json full, each with an image.
item.proof: The main.plan entries cover every suite name; main.plan.refused when a mapping is missing (scenario no-image-main).

item.check: A green main lifts a hold only when the held sha is in the range.
item.proof: N-10's test fixture using a main.gate.status from this node with the held sha outside the range: hold stays.

item.check: No seat and no architect verifies main.
item.proof: The seat contract has no verifier or merger role; routes carry no row for merged; grep routes.json for merged returns nothing after cut-over.

item.check: A red main names the first failure and every merge in the range.
item.proof: The main.gate.status 422 fields first_failure and merges in the rejected card's record.

item.check: The 31 herdr cases and every other suite pass on the current main.
item.proof: The main.gate.status 201 record id for the current main sha in the ledger.

section.title: Permissions
section.s: The Go service: the same Jenkins and GitHub permissions as N-23 and N-25; read of the mirror for the range.
Seats: none; a seat may read main.gate.status and the hold record.
The owner: may set a hold or lift it by a ruling record (N-29) only; the Controls screen (N-42) exposes it as a lamp and a one-time break glass.

section.title: Monitoring
section.s: Status fields: the newest main sha and its verdict age, runs superseded in the last day, time from merge to verdict (p50 and p95), the hold state and its age.
Alerts (N-41): main red; main unverified past main.run_bound_seconds; a hold older than PT2H with no fix ticket in flight; three supersessions in a row (a merge storm).
Map: the main lamp on the Map screen (green, red, grey for unknown) is this node's verdict; the Controls screen shows the hold.

section.title: Runbook
section.step: Main red: N-10 cut the fix ticket; the first failure and the merges are in the record; the hold lifts on the next green that covers the held sha.
Main unverified past its bound: the card names the cause (Jenkins, namespace, images, or the ladder); fix the cause, nothing here is re-run by hand; the tick re-plans.

Cut-over from line/bin/verify-main.sh: the host script stays callable but no route calls it; its hold file is read by N-10 until the merge.hold record exists, then removed by the cleanup script at the first main.gate.status 201, the step shared/cut-over.xml#step-verify names (the one cut-over order of the book).
Cleanup: ci/bin/cleanup-ci-state.sh --what verify-ranges --older-than 90d; --what legacy-hold; --what legacy-verify-worktrees; plus N-23's and N-24's.

section.title: Sources cited
section.cite: D11, ruling C39: verify is code.
D05: the status on the sha is the authority; applied to the main sha too.
D22: the full set runs as pods, not on the host.
Ruling 19:41Z: verify only the newest main; green verifies the range; red bisects (the bisect half is rejected with reason in nodes/N-10/spec.xml#rejected r-bisect).
Ruling 18:32Z: the full suite is the main verify's job.
Cause l: PR 94 merged onto red main because the hold was prose; the hold is a record.

The host verify: its breadcrumb items 1 (every suite runs), 2 (one rejected per run naming the pull requests), 3 (a green lifts a hold only for an ancestor), 4 (a timeout is red) carried here; the script retired.
The hold reader; N-09 keeps the semantics over a record.
O4 and X02: the merger verifies, the orchestrator owns; superseded by code under D11, cited so nothing is lost.
200 DONE merged and 201 PASSED verified semantics kept for N-10's records.
Rows line/bin/verify-main.sh LAND as reconciler action; WO-20261013-aff2 CI gate 4 landed here with the tick as trigger; WO-20261013-48f2 and 612d SUPERSEDED.
PR 29 verifier seat SUPERSEDE; PR 15 tester, reviewer and merger seats SUPERSEDE.
V03 merge and verify as pure functions of records and the head, three attempts, a hold for a red main.
Item 8: a full run is about 68 pods; the bound derives from measured budgets.
On main a green gate posts verified for the range since the last verified sha; a red posts rejected and sets the hold.
